title: ConfigOps
description: Request/result bodies for the config/* operations (spec.md §8.8, ADR 0055). Behind the 'config-loading' capability: an engine with no loader answers component-unavailable naming 'config-loader'.

Load.title: Load
Load.description: Load a project configuration file (lifecycle-hooks spec §6.1), YAML or JSON, through the loader janus verify --config runs (lifecycle-hooks spec §7.1).

path.description: The file, as an absolute path. The engine resolves no path against a directory of its own: a relative one is malformed-frame.

config.title: ResolvedConfig
config.description: The resolved configuration: every ${VAR} interpolated from the engine process's environment, every script inlined, every path absolute. A host puts 'components' in target.components and 'hooks' in target.hooks. It carries secrets, which the engine never repeats in a log.

version.description: The configuration's version, as the file gave it.

hooks.description: Point -> hook entries, the lifecycle-hooks spec's hook-config.schema.json document.

components.description: The project's declared components, with a file source's path made absolute (component-interfaces spec §10.2).
